clue.text: A buffer like Chopin following trunk to JFK?

indicators.note: following says the Chopin word comes after the trunk word

parts.note: what an American (JFK) calls a car's trunk, the British call the boot
Chopin was Polish

explanation.surface: A Chopin enthusiast trails a suitcase through an American airport.
explanation.walkthrough: JFK stands for America here: a car's trunk there is a boot in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Shoe polish is what you buff leather with, so it is literally an agent that buffs.

clue.text: Dead-eyed drone?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: ..., exactly accurate like a dead-eyed marksman

explanation.walkthrough: 'Dead-eyed drone' looks like a description of a bee or a dreary person; the two words are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Bang on means precisely correct, and to bang on is to go on monotonously.

clue.text: Speaking truthfully, we assume, for boat-builder, temperature dropping

indicators.note: in a down clue, dropping means the temperature letter falls lower in the column

parts.note: a letter for someone is addressed 'To' them
Noah built the ark

explanation.surface: Someone vouches for a shipwright while noting a drop in temperature.
explanation.walkthrough: TO NOAH is how a letter for the boat-builder would be addressed; the T moves down to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking under oath means under a sworn promise to tell the truth, which we presume witnesses do.

clue.text: Around the country one chases show dog

parts.note: to point to is to show or indicate
a pointer is a gundog

explanation.surface: A dog on tour around the country competes at shows.
explanation.walkthrough: A point-to-point is a British amateur cross-country horse race.
explanation.definitionFit: A point-to-pointer is a horse that races cross-country, chasing others across the countryside.

clue.text: Holiday pleasantly in isolation: "Do Not Disturb!"

parts.note: leave is time off work
well, as in getting on nicely
alone, by oneself

explanation.surface: A quiet holiday with a hotel sign hung on the door.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means don't meddle with something, the same order a hotel door sign gives.

clue.text: English actress redirected to Helsinki by deserted road?

indicators.note: redirected means sent along a new route, so the letters are rearranged
deserted means emptied, so the inside of the word road is cleared out, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: An English actress is diverted to Helsinki along an empty road.
explanation.walkthrough: ROAD emptied of its middle gives RD; that joins TO HELSINKI BY to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Dame Sybil Thorndike was a celebrated English stage actress, the first Saint Joan in Shaw's play.

clue.text: No-frills trip to see the game many miles from here

indicators.note: without frills means the trimmings at each edge of the word are cut away

parts.note: a safari is an expedition to watch wild game

explanation.surface: A budget journey to watch a match takes the fan a long way from home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the game' looks like a sports fixture; it is wild animals. Strip the S and I from the ends of SAFARI.
explanation.definitionFit: Something far off or at a great distance is afar, a long way from the speaker.

clue.text: Leave deposit on lake in the Emerald Isle

parts.note: fur is the limescale deposit inside a kettle
lough is the Irish word for a lake; the Emerald Isle is Ireland

explanation.surface: Taking time off to put down a payment on an Irish lakeside property.
explanation.definitionFit: Furlough is a period of authorised absence from work or duty.

clue.text: Not all squares in a tangram will be white

indicators.note: Not all says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A puzzle claim that some tangram pieces are coloured white.
explanation.definitionFit: Resinata is a Greek white wine flavoured with pine resin, so the hidden wine is white.

clue.text: Railwaymen joining artillerymen to support train staff, has-been porter aboard

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means sitting below the train staff pieces

parts.note: the crew of a train

indicators.note: aboard means the beer is carried inside the has-been letters

parts.note: an ex is a former partner, a has-been
porter is a dark beer, an ale
and is the word that joins
RA, the Royal Artillery

explanation.surface: Railway workers team up with gunners, backing a train crew and a washed-up luggage carrier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Railwaymen' looks like the train workers; it is the nickname of the football club from the railway town of Crewe.
explanation.definitionFit: Crewe Alexandra football club is nicknamed the Railwaymen after its town's railway history.

clue.text: Laid-back way of performing leading to ace parts in Osaka?

indicators.note: laid back means turned to lie the other way, so the letters are read in reverse
parts means the pair of letters splits apart around the other letters

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: leading to means the first piece comes before the ace letter

parts.note: MO is modus operandi, a way of doing things
A is the abbreviation for ace in cards

explanation.surface: A relaxed playing style brings aces in a tennis match in Japan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Osaka' looks like the Japanese city, and 'ace' like a tennis serve; in fact Osaka is the surname of the tennis champion, and the answer is her first name.
explanation.definitionFit: Naomi Osaka is the tennis champion, so her first name is the one completing that surname; the question mark flags this example.

clue.text: In a minute bedroom, is work unit one source of odour?

indicators.note: In says the unit of work sits inside the bedroom letters

parts.note: BR is the property-listing abbreviation for bedroom
the erg is the unit of work in physics

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about whether a tiny bedroom with a gadget in it explains a smell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'minute' looks like 'tiny' but is the time unit, M.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambergris, a waxy substance from sperm whales, is valued in perfumery for its scent.

clue.text: Run over on wagon, alien with skin of green composition

indicators.note: run over in the sense of going back over, so the whole string reads backwards
having the green word as its skin means that word wraps round the others

parts.note: eco is short for ecological, environmentally green
TT, teetotal, describes someone on the wagon
ET, the film's extra-terrestrial

explanation.surface: A green alien gets run over by a wagon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on wagon' is the idiom for giving up drink, hence teetotal; the reversal covers the whole assembled string, not just 'Run'.
explanation.definitionFit: An octette is a piece of music written for eight performers, a musical composition.

clue.text: Mean score

definitions.meaning: first meaning: ... as an adjective, base or contemptible
second meaning: the score, the real facts of a situation

explanation.walkthrough: 'Mean score' looks like an average result; the two words are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: A low-down trick is a shabby one, and the lowdown is the inside information, as in knowing the score.

clue.text: Denouement characteristic of our great detective, say?

indicators.note: say means the phrase is spoken aloud to give the sound of the answer

parts.note: a Holmes trait, a characteristic of Sherlock Holmes

explanation.surface: Asks what quality defines Britain's most famous detective.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoken quickly, 'Holmes trait' sounds like the racing phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The final stretch of a racecourse, figuratively the closing phase where everything is resolved.

clue.text: See 5
Sporting thong broke

definitions.meaning: second meaning: ... for cash, short of money

explanation.walkthrough: 'broke' looks like a past tense of break; it means penniless.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone wearing a thong is strapped into it, and being strapped means short of money.

clue.text: Double bed in father's room into which fiancée finally slips

indicators.note: slips means the letter sneaks inside the father's bed phrase

parts.note: pit is slang for a bed, so a bed in father's room is dad's pit

indicators.note: finally means just the last letter of fiancée

explanation.surface: A bride-to-be creeps into the double bed in her father's room.
explanation.definitionFit: A dead spit is an exact likeness of someone, their double or lookalike.

clue.text: Internationally, however retold, novel snubs Spain

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters are made into a new arrangement
snubs says the Spain letter is cold-shouldered, left out of the mix

parts.note: E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: A novel retold for a global readership leaves out Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retold' looks like the anagram signal but is part of the letters to be mixed; 'novel' does that job.
explanation.definitionFit: Across every country on the globe, everywhere, which is what operating internationally implies.

clue.text: Line taken on museum wrecker

indicators.note: taken on means added to the end, so the line letter follows

parts.note: the V and A, the Victoria and Albert Museum in London

explanation.surface: A museum hires a new employee who turns out to be a vandal.
explanation.definitionFit: A vandal is someone who deliberately damages or destroys property.

clue.text: A flower arrangement challenge issued by Atalanta?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a cluster of flowers along a stem
second meaning, split 4,2: Atalanta the Greek huntress challenged suitors to race her

explanation.walkthrough: 'flower arrangement' looks like floristry but is botanical. Atalanta would marry only a man who beat her in a footrace.
explanation.definitionFit: A raceme is a botanical inflorescence, and 'race me' is the dare Atalanta threw down.

clue.text: One of them to make a sizable bit of brass from a tub?

definitions.text: One of them to make a sizable bit of brass from a tub?

parts.words: One of them to make a sizable bit of brass from a tub?
parts.note: split the answer 3,3,1 as an instruction: put the letter A on the end of 'a tub', giving a tuba, a big brass instrument; each item added is one of them

explanation.walkthrough: Read as ADD END A, the answer is the instruction that turns 'a tub' into 'a tuba'. Addenda are things added, and adding is what is done here.
explanation.definitionFit: Addenda are supplementary items added at the end of a book, so each is an addition.

clue.text: See 4
Coming from behind, Gunners win (not with style!) away banker

indicators.note: coming from behind means reading from the back, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: RA, the Royal Artillery
gain is to win or acquire

indicators.note: not with style means the style word is missing from the word away

parts.note: taken as written before the cut
a way is a manner or style

explanation.surface: Arsenal, the Gunners, snatch an inelegant late away win.
explanation.walkthrough: RAGAIN reversed is NIAGAR, and AWAY without WAY leaves A. 'Banker' is the crossword trick for a river, something that has banks.
explanation.definitionFit: The Niagara is a river, and a river is a thing with banks.

clue.text: Means to save dictator a small slice of Italian sausage

parts.note: a PEP was a Personal Equity Plan, a British tax-free savings scheme
Juan Perón, the Argentine strongman

indicators.note: a small slice taken from the front of the word Italian means just its first letter

explanation.surface: A saving plan for an autocrat involves cutting a thin slice of Italian salami.
explanation.walkthrough: A PEP was a UK savings product, replaced by ISAs in 1999.
explanation.definitionFit: Pepperoni is a spicy Italian-American cured salami, often sliced onto pizza.

clue.text: Like act that goes west after Dynamo's first trick

indicators.note: after says the reversed pieces come behind the Dynamo letter
first means just the opening letter of the magician's name

parts.note: the first letter of Dynamo

indicators.note: in an across clue, going west means running right to left, so the like-and-act letters reverse

parts.note: EG, for example, as in 'like'
to do is to act

explanation.surface: A routine by a stage performer called Dynamo travels west.
explanation.walkthrough: Dynamo is a British street magician, which makes 'trick' natural. EG and DO together, EGDO, reversed give ODGE.
explanation.definitionFit: A dodge is a crafty ruse or trick for getting round something.

clue.text: See what day it is

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to see someone is to go out with them romantically

explanation.walkthrough: The whole reads as 'check the calendar'; split it after 'See'.
explanation.definitionFit: To date someone is to be seeing them, and today's date is the calendar day.

clue.text: Brief climb down around path of French soldier

indicators.note: around means turned round, so the shortened word reads backwards
brief means cut short, so the last letter goes

parts.note: to renege is to back down from a commitment
allée is French for a path or avenue

explanation.surface: A short descent around a French path.
explanation.walkthrough: RENEG reversed gives GENER.
explanation.definitionFit: Robert E. Lee was the Confederate commander in the American Civil War, a soldier.
